images.filename: Inside the 'Picture House', Ulster Folk Museum - geograph.org.uk - 1107590.jpg
images.caption: Inside the 'Picture House', Ulster Folk Museum The 'Picture House' in the Ulster Folk Museum is a replica of one which stood in Gilford, County Armagh. It ran as a silent cinema from c1909-c1931. Showing here was a Charlie Chaplin picture.
images.alt: Inside the 'Picture House', Ulster Folk Museum The 'Picture House' in the Ulster Folk Museum is a replica of one which stood in Gilford, County Armagh. It ran as a silent cinema from c1909-c1931. Showing here was a Charlie Chaplin picture.

images.filename: A village street scene at the Irish Folk Museum - geograph.org.uk - 1160477.jpg
images.caption: A village street scene at the Irish Folk Museum This jewel, near Ballycultra, is the most impressive museum of its kind in the British Isles. Real houses, cafes, shops, court, police station, churches, school and post office etc. etc. etc. Have been saved from demolition and removed stone by stone and built in this wonderful place. A veritable gem in Northern Ireland's crown. A must see experience.
images.alt: A village street scene at the Irish Folk Museum This jewel, near Ballycultra, is the most impressive museum of its kind in the British Isles. Real houses, cafes, shops, court, police station, churches, school and post office etc. etc. etc. Have been saved from demolition and removed stone by stone and built in this wonderful place. A veritable gem in Northern Ireland's crown. A must see experience.
categories: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland
